response:
I'm so deeply sorry for the loss of your baby. This is one of the most profound kinds of grief, and there is no right way to move through it—only your way, at your own pace.

Please be gentle with yourself. It's okay to cry, to feel numb, angry, or lost, and to have good moments too. You don't have to carry this alone. Leaning on a partner, trusted friend, or family member can help, and many people find comfort in support groups for pregnancy and infant loss, where others truly understand. Speaking with a grief counselor or therapist can also give you space to process what you're feeling.

If you ever feel overwhelmed by thoughts of hurting yourself or that you can't go on, please reach out right away to a crisis line or emergency services—you deserve support in that moment.

Your baby mattered, and so does your grief. Take things one moment at a time.
